title: urnetwork / sim-latency competition
description: Authenticated operator diagnostics, including per-submission comparisons against the selected epoch baseline. Private scores and winner eligibility must not be publicly shared before the frozen reveal boundary.

panels.title: artifact object lock
panels.description: Alert immediately while this is 0. Production score commits fail closed without retained MinIO.

panels.title: durable worker lease heartbeat age
panels.description: Database lease health. Page when above 60 seconds for five minutes, or -1 while a competition is open/grading. A drained epoch in honesty review intentionally has no worker.

panels.title: running
panels.description: Alert for a stalled queue when queued > 0 and running = 0 for five minutes during grading.

panels.title: metric refresh errors (1h)
panels.description: Page on any increase; queue/heartbeat gauges are stale when this is nonzero.

panels.title: evaluation outcomes
panels.description: Page when infrastructure_failed or rebaseline_mismatch increases; investigate retries before the attempt cap.

panels.title: retained artifact volume
panels.description: Pair this with the MinIO capacity dashboard. Warn below 25% free; page below 10% free or on any artifact failure.

panels.title: retained objects and configured processes
panels.description: Object count excludes the enclosing manifest. Configured should remain one for every API/worker process in the selected environment.

panels.title: runner heartbeat age
panels.description: The sim-latency runner emits a process heartbeat every 15 seconds. Orange means no heartbeat has been heard for more than 30 seconds; red means more than 60 seconds. This is expected after the drained epoch enters honesty review.

panels.title: submission queue
panels.description: Submissions waiting in the durable FIFO. The count is authoritative PostgreSQL state; Redis is a rebuildable FIFO dispatch index.

panels.title: current evaluation elapsed
panels.description: Wall time consumed by the current submission. Every submission has a hard three-hour evaluation budget.

panels.title: estimated FIFO drain time
panels.description: Estimated current remaining time plus queued submissions, using the recent completed-evaluation p75 and the three-hour limit before enough history exists.

panels.title: significant submission found
panels.description: One after any completed submission in the current epoch passes the recorded statistical-significance test. Results remain internal until epoch finalization.

panels.title: evaluation duration estimate
panels.description: Recent completed-evaluation p75 used by the drain-time estimate; falls back to the three-hour evaluation limit when no history exists.

panels.title: current submission
panels.description: Internal identity of the one submission currently being evaluated. No series means the runner is idle.

panels.title: live TTFB p50 by replicate
panels.description: Internal live reveal after each completed replicate. Green is baseline, blue is a provisional statistically significant improvement, red is a significant regression, and gray is not significant at one-sided p≤0.05. The final sealed composite score remains authoritative.

targets.expr: max by (job_id, role, replicate, significance) (urnetwork_competition_live_evaluation_metric_value{env="$env",host=~"$host",metric="ttfb_p50_ms"}) and on(job_id) max by (job_id) (urnetwork_competition_current_evaluation_info{env="$env",host=~"$host"})

panels.title: live TTFB p95 by replicate
panels.description: Internal live reveal after each completed replicate. Green is baseline, blue is a provisional statistically significant improvement, red is a significant regression, and gray is not significant at one-sided p≤0.05. The final sealed composite score remains authoritative.

targets.expr: max by (job_id, role, replicate, significance) (urnetwork_competition_live_evaluation_metric_value{env="$env",host=~"$host",metric="ttfb_p95_ms"}) and on(job_id) max by (job_id) (urnetwork_competition_current_evaluation_info{env="$env",host=~"$host"})

panels.title: live throughput p50 by replicate

panels.title: current era
panels.description: Zero is production or pre-round idle; one is the independently numbered fee-free staging era.

panels.title: score snapshot complete and fresh
panels.description: Operator-only stored-score inventory, not evaluator readiness. Zero means unavailable, stale, invalid or over the configured point limit; no partial inventory is shown.

panels.title: completed scores in selected round
panels.description: Every valid numeric completed score in a successful snapshot is included, including failed gates. Queued jobs and failures without valid numeric statistics have no fabricated zero. Overflow fails closed rather than displaying a silent latest-N subset.

panels.title: score source snapshot age
panels.description: Age uses the producer's original observation timestamp, never a new ingestion timestamp. All plots are hidden after the producer's configured maximum age.

panels.title: stored terminal score records
panels.description: All bounded same-round terminal records with stored score JSON, including early failed reports. On a complete fresh snapshot this equals plotted scores plus the unplottable-failure count. Failures with SQL-NULL scores remain in the existing durable job-state totals.

panels.title: failed reports without plottable statistics
panels.description: Explicitly counted early failures with stored reports but no complete positive numeric score/significance. They are not zero-latency points. Failed evaluations with real complete numeric scores remain plotted in red.

options.content: Choose one **score round**. The four plots share the same submission-time x axis: each point is one completed submission, not a replicate or a scrape. Green lines are the epoch's stored baseline; amber is its median takeover ceiling; purple is the variance-dependent Welch mean boundary. Blue points meet recorded numerical takeover conditions, cyan are statistically significant but not takeover eligible, gray are not significant, and red failed a gate. **Numerical eligibility is not a winner or honesty approval.** These internal plots do not change the public embargo. Median ranking and mean-based significance are separate tests. The producer exports the entire bounded snapshot or no points, never an undisclosed latest-N subset.

panels.title: submission median score versus epoch baseline
panels.description: Lower is better. Raw score is the median of replicate p95 total request latencies, NOT TTFB. Green is the immutable epoch median baseline; amber is baseline × (1 − frozen takeover margin). The separate statistical fringe is shown on the aligned mean panel below, not misrepresented as a median cutoff.

panels.title: mean improvement versus statistical and practical margins
panels.description: Higher is better. Points use the stored observed mean improvement percentage. Green is zero improvement; purple is the stored candidate-specific significance requirement; amber is the frozen practical margin for reference. Actual takeover also requires the MEDIAN ceiling above plus all gates; crossing a mean percentage alone is not sufficient.
